purpose: Settle accepted IME composition exactly once, restoring original Rope identity for byte no-ops.
Preserve scoped history ownership, outer transaction metadata, token semantics, and redo across cancellation.
Publish Undo/Redo as a bounded, final-snapshot committed transition without preedit snapshots.
Adopt an already validated Rope only into a fresh EditorMode state without an initial edit transaction or full-text copies.
Build row layout from sequential LF lines directly into SumTree while preserving incremental splice and width-reuse semantics.
Fast-path bounded single-row fit checks and reuse wrap scratch buffers, defer pre-initialization layout setter rewraps until prepare_if_need, and drop stale SumTree rows before full-replace rebuilds.
